chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 4 - Legislature is the MCL chapter that houses the Lobbyists Registration Act (Act 472 of 1978, MCL 4.411-4.431).

notes: MI MCL is organized by named Acts grouped within numbered chapters. Lobbying-disclosure regime = Lobbyists Registration Act, Act 472 of 1978 (MCL 4.411-4.431), housed in Chapter 4 (Legislature). Chapter 169 (Campaign Financing and Advertising) intentionally excluded as it covers campaign finance, a separate regime.
